image_description: A cooked Dungeness crab served in a white bowl, viewed from a high angle. The crab is bright orange-red, indicating it has been boiled or steamed. The carapace is intact, and several legs and claws are visible, though some appear broken or disjointed due to the cooking/serving process. There are green garnish stems (likely scallions) in the foreground. The lighting is dim and warm.
